answer.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test to improve time-to-value and early retention without matching the competitor's price cut. The confirmed onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable value creation. Promotional pricing produced strong acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating a downstream qualified-revenue risk; it should not be generalized as the response. Monitor price-sensitive SMB churn and retention closely during the test.
